LanguageData.Gun_OTs-14-4A-01_Groza-4_RWP.label: OTs-14-4A-01 Groza-4
LanguageData.Gun_OTs-14-4A-01_Groza-4_RWP.description: The OTs-14-4A-01 Groza-4 is a versatile bullpup assault rifle with an integrated suppressor, designed for high accuracy and controlled recoil. Its compact structure makes it ideal for close-quarters combat, while the powerful 9x39mm rounds ensure significant damage output against armored targets.
